title: Retry the Vault prepare live plan with the approved Terraform role
classification_reason: reads current Terraform state and cloud metadata
uses a scoped cross-role planning identity
reviews a security-sensitive EKS bootstrap boundary
expected_outcome: A refresh-backed prepare plan from the state-aligned remediation branch uses the approved Terraform role, includes no Argo CD deletes or cluster-admin association, and is safe to submit for separate apply review.
constraints: Use AWS_PROFILE=node-operator-t2 and its existing ExternalId-controlled role only.

The only IAM mutations are adding eks:DescribeAccessEntry to the existing EKS statement and codebuild:BatchGetProjects to the existing NodeOperatorTerraformApply policy; do not add write actions or broaden resources.
Set Vault runner=true and Vault cluster-admin=false; preserve the deployed Argo CD bootstrap configuration.
No Terraform apply, CodeBuild execution, Helm, kubectl, Vault, secret access, EKS access-policy mutation, merge, or publication.
Retain no credentials, raw Terraform state, kubeconfig, secret data, or raw service logs.

external_actions: assume the existing NodeOperatorTerraformApply role through the configured local profile
update the existing NodeOperatorT2ScopedApply role policy solely to add eks:DescribeAccessEntry and codebuild:BatchGetProjects
read-only Terraform backend initialization and refresh-backed plan
prohibited_actions: any IAM action other than the two exact approved policy additions

primary_owner.responsibility: planning-identity boundary, plan review, integration, and sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: role can mutate or state data is sensitive
